channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2025-24893 — XWiki Platform
item.description: Threat Signal 80. XWiki Platform contains an eval injection vulnerability that could allow any guest to perform arbitrary remote code execution through a request to SolrSearch.

item.title: CVE-2025-59287 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-1000353 — Jenkins Jenkins
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Jenkins contains a remote code execution vulnerability. This vulnerability that could allowed attackers to transfer a serialized Java SignedObject object to the remoting-based Jenkins CLI, that would be deserialized using a new ObjectInputStream, bypassing the existing blocklist-based protection mechanism.

item.title: CVE-2025-20281 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2025-25257 — Fortinet FortiWeb
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Fortinet FortiWeb contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized SQL code or commands via crafted HTTP or HTTPs requests.

item.title: CVE-2016-10033 — PHP PHPMailer
item.description: Threat Signal 80. PHPMailer contains a command injection vulnerability because it fails to sanitize user-supplied input. Specifically, this issue affects the 'mail()' function of 'class.phpmailer.php' script. An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code within the context of the application. Failed exploit attempts will result in a denial-of-service condition.

item.title: CVE-2025-32433 — Erlang Erlang/OTP
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited to—Cisco, NetApp, and SUSE.

item.title: CVE-2021-32030 — ASUS Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-24813 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache Tomcat contains a path equivalence vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code, disclose information, or inject malicious content via a partial PUT request. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2026‑34486.

item.title: CVE-2024-4885 — Progress WhatsUp Gold
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-19410 — Paessler PRTG Network Monitor
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

item.title: CVE-2024-50603 — Aviatrix Controllers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.

item.title: CVE-2023-48365 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2024-9463 — Palo Alto Networks Expedition
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary OS commands as root in Expedition, resulting in disclosure of usernames, cleartext passwords, device configurations, and device API keys of PAN-OS firewalls.

item.title: CVE-2019-16278 — Nostromo nhttpd
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Nostromo nhttpd contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the http_verify() function in a non-chrooted nhttpd server allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-45519 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an unspecified vulnerability in the postjournal service that may allow an unauthenticated user to execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2023-25280 — D-Link DIR-820 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 80. D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp.

item.title: CVE-2024-7593 — Ivanti Virtual Traffic Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ivanti Virtual Traffic Manager contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create a chosen administrator account.

item.title: CVE-2024-27348 — Apache HugeGraph-Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache HugeGraph-Server contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2014-0497 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Adobe Flash Player contains an integer underflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2024-38856 — Apache OFBiz
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache OFBiz contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow remote code execution via a Groovy payload in the context of the OFBiz user process by an unauthenticated attacker.

item.title: CVE-2021-33045 — Dahua IP Camera Firmware
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the loopback device is specified by the client during authentication.

item.title: CVE-2021-33044 — Dahua IP Camera Firmware
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the NetKeyboard type argument is specified by the client during authentication.

item.title: CVE-2024-32113 — Apache OFBiz
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache OFBiz contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-34102 — Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper restriction of XML external entity reference (XXE) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-36401 — OSGeo GeoServer
item.description: Threat Signal 80. OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools contains an improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code vulnerability due to unsafely evaluating property names as XPath expressions. This allows unauthenticated attackers to conduct remote code execution via specially crafted input.

item.title: CVE-2022-24816 — OSGeo JAI-EXT
item.description: Threat Signal 80. OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT contains a code injection vulnerability that, when programs use jt-jiffle and allow Jiffle script to be provided via network request, could allow remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-4040 — CrushFTP CrushFTP
item.description: Threat Signal 80. CrushFTP contains an unspecified sandbox escape vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to escape the CrushFTP virtual file system (VFS).

item.title: CVE-2024-3273 — D-Link Multiple NAS Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 80. D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contain a command injection vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2024-3272, this can lead to remote, unauthorized code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-3272 — D-Link Multiple NAS Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 80. D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contains a hard-coded credential that allows an attacker to conduct authenticated command injection, leading to remote, unauthorized code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-36380 — Sunhillo SureLine
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Sunhillo SureLine contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to cause a denial-of-service or utilize the device for persistence on the network via shell metacharacters in ipAddr or dnsAddr in /cgi/networkDiag.cgi.

item.title: CVE-2023-34048 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-27524 — Apache Superset
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache Superset contains an insecure default initialization of a resource vulnerability that allows an attacker to authenticate and access unauthorized resources on installations that have not altered the default configured SECRET_KEY according to installation instructions.

item.title: CVE-2023-41266 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Qlik Sense contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an anonymous session by sending maliciously crafted HTTP requests. This anonymous session could allow the attacker to send further requests to unauthorized endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2023-1671 — Sophos Web Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Sophos Web Appliance contains a command injection vulnerability in the warn-proceed handler that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-20198 — Cisco IOS XE Web UI
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cisco IOS XE Web UI contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the web user interface that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access. The attacker can then use that account to gain control of the affected device.

item.title: CVE-2014-8361 — Realtek SDK
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Realtek SDK contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the miniigd SOAP service that allows remote attackers to execute malicious code via a crafted NewInternalClient request.

item.title: CVE-2022-29303 — SolarView Compact
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SolarView Compact contains a command injection vulnerability due to improper validation of input values on the send test mail console of the product's web server.

item.title: CVE-2023-20887 — VMware Aria Operations for Networks
item.description: Threat Signal 80. VMware Aria Operations for Networks (formerly vRealize Network Insight) contains a command injection vulnerability that allows a malicious actor with network access to perform an attack resulting in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-28771 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls allow for improper error message handling which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute OS commands remotely by sending crafted packets to an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-25717 — Ruckus Wireless Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ruckus Wireless Access Point (AP) software contains an unspecified vulnerability in the web services component. If the web services component is enabled on the AP, an attacker can perform cross-site request forgery (CSRF) or remote code execution (RCE). This vulnerability impacts Ruckus ZoneDirector, SmartZone, and Solo APs.

item.title: CVE-2022-35914 — Teclib GLPI
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Teclib GLPI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the third-party library, htmlawed.

item.title: CVE-2022-46169 — Cacti Cacti
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cacti contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2022-44877 — CWP Control Web Panel
item.description: Threat Signal 80. CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute commands via shell metacharacters in the login parameter.

item.title: CVE-2022-3236 — Sophos Firewall
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-35405 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-2628 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.

item.title: CVE-2022-22963 — VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud
item.description: Threat Signal 80. When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

item.title: CVE-2022-22536 — SAP Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 80. SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.

item.title: CVE-2017-15944 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.
